strings.Alle zwölf Kennzahlen, ihre Definitionen: All twelve KPIs, their definitions and monthly values
strings.Vier Kennzahlen zu Termintreue, Schäden: Four KPIs for punctuality, damage and unit costs · As of
strings.Vier Kennzahlen zu Auslastung, Umschlag,: Four KPIs for utilisation, turnover, inventory and picking quality · As of
strings.Vier Kennzahlen zu Produktivität, Wartez: Four KPIs for productivity, waiting time and emissions · As of
strings.Segmentbalken = Zielerreichung · Marke =: Segment bar = target attainment · Marker = target
strings.Fahrzeuge im Tagesmittel · Basis der Ram: Daily average vehicles · Dock planning basis
strings.Belegte Stellplätze im Monatsmittel · Zi: Monthly average occupied slots · Target band 85–92 %
strings.Minuten von Ankunft bis Andocken · Ziel: Minutes from arrival to docking · Target ≤ 45 min
strings.Transportemissionen je Sendung · Ziel ≤: Transport emissions per shipment · Target ≤ 32.0 kg
strings.Anteil der Ausgangssendungen, die vollst: Share of outbound shipments delivered in full and on time.
strings.Anteil der Anlieferungen, die im avisier: Share of inbound deliveries within the announced time window. Late arrivals delay putaway.
strings.pünktliche Anlieferungen ÷ Anlieferungen: On-time inbound deliveries ÷ total inbound deliveries
strings.Anteil der Sendungen mit Transportschade: Share of shipments damaged or lost in transit; a key customer quality indicator.
strings.Lager- und Transportkosten, umgelegt auf: Warehouse and transport costs per outbound shipment; shows whether volume growth reduces unit costs.
strings.Belegte Palettenstellplätze im Monatsmit: Monthly average occupied pallet slots. Low occupancy wastes space; high occupancy increases travel and search time.
strings.Wie oft sich der Bestand im Jahr komplet: Annual inventory rotations. Higher turnover means less capital tied up per pallet moved.
strings.Wie gut der Systembestand dem physischen: Agreement between system and physical stock, measured through cycle counting.
strings.Anteil fehlerhaft kommissionierter Posit: Share of picked lines with wrong quantity, item or location.
strings.Kommissionierte Positionen je produktive: Picked lines per productive working hour; a core warehouse productivity indicator.
strings.Zeit vom Eintreffen des Fahrers bis zum: Time from driver arrival to docking. Long waits cause detention costs and burden carriers.
strings.Ø Minuten Ankunft bis Andockzeitpunkt: Average minutes from arrival to docking
strings.Anteil der Anwesenheitszeit, der auf wer: Share of attendance time spent creating value; the rest is waiting, searching or setup.
strings.Transportemissionen, umgelegt auf eine S: Transport emissions per shipment; increasingly important in contract awards.
strings.Ausgangssendungen geteilt durch die Arbe: Outbound shipments divided by working days in the month.
strings.Anliefernde Fahrzeuge im Tagesmittel – G: Average daily arriving vehicles; basis for dock and staff planning.
strings.Abgehende Fahrzeuge im Tagesmittel – zei: Average daily departing vehicles; indicates outbound dock workload.
strings.Die Kennzahlen greifen auf Objekte zu, d: KPIs use shipment, delivery note, warehouse order, posting and inventory records. In SAP S/4HANA these are in MM, SD and EWM; other providers use their TMS and WMS. The formula stays the same; only its data source changes.
strings.Demo für Logistikdienstleister. Sämtlich: Demo for logistics providers. All values are simulated and do not represent any specific company or site. Design and calculation: Rahmatallah Fakhri Fakhrabadi, Konstanz.
strings.pünktlich und vollständig zugestellte Se: On-time and complete shipments ÷ total shipments
strings.Genutzte Lademeter im Verhältnis zu den: Used loading metres relative to the loading metres available on outbound trucks. Low values mean half-empty trips and higher cost per shipment.
strings.Wie viele Kalendertage der durchschnittl: How many calendar days the average inventory lasts at the current outbound rate. High coverage ties up capital and space.
strings.Zeit von der Entladung an der Rampe bis: Time from unloading at the dock until stock is booked and available. Short times make goods available sooner.
strings.Ø Stunden Entladung bis Einlagerungsbuch: Avg. hours from unloading to putaway posting
strings.Warenausgang (auf 12 Monate hochgerechne: Outbound goods (annualised to 12 months) ÷ avg. inventory

strings.Fünf Kennzahlen zu Auslastung, Umschlag,: Five KPIs for utilisation, turnover, coverage, inventory and picking quality · As of

copy: Interactive demo dashboard with fifteen logistics KPIs, targets and monthly trends. All data is simulated and does not represent a real company.
